<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：雪原　第５マーカー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、メイン・パワー・ジェネレータが場に出ているなら、フォース消耗に－１。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズに、ここから山脈にフォースを消費せずに直接移動できる。逆もまた可。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Ice-Plains-5th-Marker-PSA-151452826.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: snow field, 5th Marker.

'''Light Side:'''
If you control, and Main Power Generators is on table, Force drain -1 here.

'''Dark Side:'''
During your move phase, you may move from here directly to Mountains without spending Force, and vice versa.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
